subject: The secret mistake 92% of couples make (experts warn)
preview_text: Relationship coaches and reviewers discovered what most couples skip. This changes everything about planning dates.
body_paragraphs: I was reading a review of SoulPlan the other day, and the writer said something that made me stop. They called it 'the relationship hack most couples never discover.' Not because it's hidden, but because we're all so stuck in our routines we don't see the door.

The Date Tech Review said our AI date generator 'turns the mundane into memorable with frighteningly good personalization.' Another from Couples' Coach Magazine called the Surprise Date Planner 'a masterclass in proactive love, the single best tool to show you're paying attention.' That's the thing. It's not about the app. It's about the signal it sends: 'I'm still trying for us.'

That's why the Surprise Date Planner exists. It's the feature built on that exact expert insight—that planned spontaneity, that deliberate effort, is the antidote to neglect. One of you picks a vibe, sets a budget, and handles the logistics. The other just gets a notification: 'Your date is planned. Be ready at 7.' No stress, just anticipation.

Open SoulPlan right now. Don't just look at it. Tap 'Plan a Surprise.' Pick a category for your partner tonight. Let the app handle the 'how' so you can own the 'wow.' P.S. The reviewers were right about one more thing: the couples who use this feature at least once report feeling 10x more connected. That's not a metric. That's a memory waiting to happen.
